column1: # Whole string overrides, applied after fork/strings-sanitize.tsv.
# The key is removed from every values-*/strings.xml (so no locale can bring the
# old wording back) and the value below is written to values/strings.xml.
# Format: name<TAB>value  (\n is written as an escaped newline)
# sick_mode_notice: the upstream text mixes the names of two *other* apps
# ("HMA/HMAL ... HMA-OSS") in a way that cannot be token-replaced without
# producing nonsense, so the message is replaced as a whole.

column2: This module can read configuration backups written by other app-list hiding modules. If another one is installed, uninstall it and reboot first.
